C-STABILIZE-AUTO-RESIZE-WRAP.Summary: Preserve no-scroll wrapping when Auto reconciles fixed column geometry, and verify real resize behavior at and below the frame limit.
C-STABILIZE-AUTO-RESIZE-WRAP.ApprovalBasis: Owner-delegated recovery; PR199 head5f1abc passed445Chromium,37WebKit core and65WebKit performance cases, then exposed fixed-column overflow and an invalid unclamped-growth fixture assumption in WebKit.

Goals.Goal: Auto reconciliation never removes required wrapping from fixed/manual geometry. Every column and its text remain inside the frame; narrow natural sizing, explicit Auto reset, Fit/Full and stored manual widths remain compatible.
Real pointer tests distinguish unconstrained growth from frame clamping after actual layout completion and preserve manual viewer geometry.

Constraints.Item: No force click, arbitrary delay, wider tolerance, skip, timeout, performance/coverage-floor or dependency change. Preserve profile/history/dirty semantics and existing fit mathematics.

NonGoals.Item: No new sizing mode, toolbar design, native behavior, version or release change.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-012 TableResize reconciliation and its existing unit/browser verification.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The original class-loss defect reproduces before the fix; fixed Auto cells wrap after repeated reconciliation and remain visible after wide drag. Existing minimum48px and frame-bound clamps remain; a genuinely slack fixture proves full non-clamped pointer growth.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red/green fixed-width reconciliation tests, Chromium/WebKit table/viewer matrix, unchanged coverage floors and fresh application artifact when production input changes.
